sessions.title: Maya and Ethan Hawke’s Closet Picks
sessions.description: The father-daughter team behind the new film Wildcat talk about their love of Children of Paradise, the films of Wim Wenders, and the influence of Picnic at Hanging Rock and An Angel at My Table.

sessions.title: Ethan Hawke and Jonathan Marc Sherman’s Closet Picks
sessions.description: Longtime friends and collaborators Ethan Hawke and Jonathan Marc Sherman stopped by the office to contribute to our new edition of Baal—and have some fun in the closet.
